info.title: A .NET global tool to alphabetically sort package references in .csproj, .fsproj and .props files.
info.description: A .NET global tool to alphabetically sort package references in .csproj, .fsproj and .props files.

options.name: --inspect
options.description:
Specifies whether to inspect and return a non-zero exit code if
one or more projects have non-sorted package references.

arguments.name: Path
arguments.description:
The path to a .csproj, .fsproj or .props file, or a directory.
If a directory is specified, all .csproj, .fsproj and .props
files within the folder tree will be processed, skipping bin and
obj folders. If none is specified, the current directory is
used.
